method: Model-assisted open qualitative reading: full output.raw_text presented per layer/question in ascending 11-dose order; 2 or 4 questions (22 or 44 cells) per batch; no prefix extraction, regex semantic classification, scoring, new model/API/GPU inference, or conclusions inherited from A.
baseline_identity: Eight shared baselines retain layer=null and channel=null. Group layer is presentation context only.

tool_truncation.excluded_prework: Combined project-document output, large receipt dump and a code-location lookup were truncated. These were context/metadata reads, never counted as raw_text coverage. Protocol, question prompts and completion receipt summary were separately inspected.

resume_event.reported_by_parent: User reset quota and requested continuation

limitations: One model-assisted reader for this shard; no independent blind review or quantitative semantic evaluation.
Only eight fixed questions and one preselected channel per layer; no population-risk or natural-layer-function inference.
128-token generation cap remains part of source; full reading cannot complete unfinished answers.
Baseline has accusatory wording in Q03, blank lines in Q04 and inconsistent February listing in Q08.
